Select molecule_chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles
Join activities ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Join assays ON assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id
Join target_dictionary ON target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid
Join compound_structures ON compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter target_dictionary.tid = 4822
Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
Filter activities.type = 'IC50'
Filter activities.standard_relation = '='
Filter activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL
Sort by molecule_chembl_id
